description: An Rsbuild plugin that builds a Lynx app with the Rsbuild CLI directly, without the Rspeedy CLI.

exports.name: BundleFilenameContext
exports.summary: The context passed to the [`LynxFilename.bundle`](api:LynxFilename.bundle) function.

members.name: entryName
members.remarks:
It is `undefined` for lazy bundles, since a lazy bundle name is resolved
per async chunk instead of per entry.

members.name: lazyBundle
members.summary:
Whether the filename is being resolved for a lazy bundle (async chunk)
instead of the main bundle of an entry.

members.name: platform
members.summary: The name of the Rsbuild environment.

exports.name: LynxConfig
exports.summary: The Lynx config that `pluginLynx` exposes to other plugins.
exports.remarks:
The data mirrors [`LynxPluginOptions`](api:LynxPluginOptions), so a plugin reads
`config.output.filename` the same way it reads `output.filename` from
`api.getRsbuildConfig()`. Values that depend on the entry being built are
derived by the methods, which travel with the data so that the plugin that
built the config is always the one that resolves it.

params.name: context
params.description: The entry to resolve the name for.

members.summary: Resolve the name of the bundle file of an entry.

members.name: resolveIntermediateDir

params.name: context
params.description:
The entry to resolve the directory for. Without an entry
name, the directory that holds every entry's is returned.

members.summary: Resolve the directory of the intermediate files.
members.remarks:
A Lynx bundle is encoded from per-thread JS, CSS and HMR outputs. They are
emitted into this directory, per entry, instead of next to the bundle.

members.name: resolveLazyBundleFilename

params.name: context
params.description: The environment to resolve the name for.

returns.description:
The resolved name, or `undefined` when [`LynxFilename.bundle`](api:LynxFilename.bundle)
is not a function. A lazy bundle name can only be customized by a function,
since it is resolved per async chunk, so `undefined` means the caller
leaves the name to `LynxTemplatePlugin`.

members.summary: Resolve the name of the lazy bundle files.
members.remarks:
There is no entry name to resolve `[name]` with, so the placeholder is
kept for `LynxTemplatePlugin` to fill in per async chunk.

exports.name: LynxFilename
exports.summary: The names of the files emitted by the Lynx build engine.

members.name: bundle
members.summary: The name of the bundle files.
members.remarks:
The following placeholders are supported:

- `[name]`: the name of the entry.
- `[platform]`: the name of the Rsbuild environment.

exports.name: LynxMinify
exports.summary: The minifier options of the Lynx threads.
exports.remarks:
Lynx emits one bundle per thread, and each thread may need different
minifier settings. These are merged on top of the Rsbuild
`output.minify.jsOptions` and applied to that thread only.

members.name: backgroundOptions
members.summary: The minifier options of the background thread.

members.name: mainThreadOptions
members.summary: The minifier options of the main thread.

exports.name: LynxOutput
exports.summary: The build outputs of the Lynx build engine.

members.name: filename
members.summary: The names of the emitted files.

exports.name: LynxPerformance
exports.summary: The performance options of the Lynx build engine.

members.name: profile
members.summary:
Whether to capture timing information in Lynx runtime integrations such as
ReactLynx.
members.remarks:
A framework includes runtime information using `console.profile` when this
is enabled.

exports.name: PLUGIN_LYNX_NAME
exports.summary:
The name of the plugin that marks `pluginLynx` as applied. Use it with
`api.isPluginExists` to tell whether the Lynx build engine is already there.

params.name: host
params.description: The Rsbuild instance or plugin API to look it up on.

params.name: environments
params.description: The names of the configured environments.

signatures.summary: Whether the Lynx build engine is already registered.
signatures.remarks:
The engine is a global one. `isPluginExists` without an environment only
reports the global plugins, so it misses an engine a caller — `rslib`, for
one — registered on an environment instead.
